statement: For every integer n>=3, every real n-by-n doubly stochastic matrix A, and every t in [1/2,1], let J_n have all entries 1/n. Prove or refute per(t J_n+(1-t) A) <= t per(J_n)+(1-t) per(A).
goals: All n and all doubly stochastic A and t in the stated closed interval, or one exact counterexample.
prior_notes: Prior discussions used s=1-t in [0,1/2] and a proposed integral estimate; rederive any lemma before reuse. Published partial results exist; check final published version rather than assuming arXiv claims apply to all n.
routes: Birkhoff polytope extremal structure and perturbation
block matrices / regular bipartite graph permanents
